name: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4（TP=4 · DFlash2）
description: GLM-5.3-Flash（320B/A18B MoE，glm5_next）NVFP4 量化四节点 TP=4 服务（上游当前默认配置：fp8 KV + DFlash2 k=7 块扩散投机）：ACR 烘焙 v11-dflash2 镜像（上游 v1→v9 patch 栈 + DFlash2 overlay + SM121 indexer 模块烘焙）、fp8_e4m3 KV（每 rank 24GiB = 3,895,606-token 池，3.72× 满 1M）、默认 RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint（compressed-tensors，修复 ModelOpt token 损坏）、1,048,576 上下文；2026-08-29 gate 通过：单流 54.5 tok/s、prefill 4,141.8 tok/s。
compose_template:
services:
  vllm-glm53:
    image: ${GLM53_IMAGE:-registry.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/aixn-public/glm53-flash-sm121:v11-dflash2}
    container_name: ${TASK_NAME}-rank${NODE_RANK}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python3", "-c", "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:${VLLM_PORT:-8000}/health', timeout=5).status == 200 else 1)"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 900s
    pull_policy: if_not_present
    entrypoint: []
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: "32gb"
    ulimits:
      memlock: -1
      stack: 67108864
      nofile: 1048576
    gpus: all
    devices:
      - /dev/infiniband:/dev/infiniband
    volumes:
      # 生产 launcher 把权重挂在 /cache/huggingface（HF_HOME 指向它）
      - ${HF_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}:/cache/huggingface
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"  # 模型由管理平台分发到节点缓存，固定离线加载
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET: "${HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET:-1}"
      TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE: "1"
      VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S: "3600"
      # Triton / FlashInfer JIT 编译缓存挂已持久化的 HF 缓存内，容器重建不丢
      TRITON_CACHE_DIR: "${TRITON_CACHE_DIR:-/cache/huggingface/.tritoncache-glm53}"
      FLASHINFER_JIT_CACHE_DIR: "${FLASHINFER_JIT_CACHE_DIR:-/cache/huggingface/.flashinfer-glm53}"
      # SM121 架构 + fp8 KV 所需（源 launcher 全部保留）
      TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "12.1a"
      FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "12.1a"
      FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK: "1"
      PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF: expandable_segments:True
      VLLM_HOST_IP: "${VLLM_HOST_IP:-}"
      # 网络：RoCE，HCA 由 hca 自动键逗号分隔填充；GID 每启动动态解析
      NCCL_NET: "${NCCL_NET:-IB}"
      NCCL_IB_DISABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IB_HCA: "${NCCL_IB_HCA:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX: "${NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_AUTO: "1"
      NCCL_IB_ADDR_FAMILY: AF_INET
      NCCL_IB_ROCE_VERSION_NUM: 2
      NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME:-}"
      GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_CROSS_NIC: "0"
      NCCL_IB_MERGE_NICS: "0"
      NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY: "1"
      NCCL_DEBUG: WARN
      TORCH_NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING: "1"
    command:
      - bash
      - -lc
      - >
        export PATH="/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/bin:$${PATH:-}";
        export CUDA_HOME="$${CUDA_HOME:-/usr/local/cuda}";
        export CUDA_PATH="$${CUDA_PATH:-$${CUDA_HOME}}";
        export CUDAToolkit_ROOT="$${CUDAToolkit_ROOT:-$${CUDA_HOME}}";
        export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/usr/local/cuda/lib64:$${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}";
        exec /usr/local/bin/vllm serve ${GLM53_MODEL_PATH:-RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4}
        --served-model-name ${SERVED_MODEL_NAME:-glm-5.3-flash}
        --host ${VLLM_HOST:-0.0.0.0}
        --port ${VLLM_PORT:-8000}
        --trust-remote-code
        --tensor-parallel-size 4
        --gpu-memory-utilization ${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:-0.85}
        --max-model-len ${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-1048576}
        --max-num-seqs ${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-6}
        --max-num-batched-tokens ${MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS:-8192}
        --block-size 2304
        --moe-backend marlin
        --speculative-config '{"method":"dflash","model":"${GLM53_DRAFT_PATH:-incoai/GLM-5.3-Flash-DFlash2}","num_speculative_tokens":${DFLASH2_NUM_SPECULATIVE_TOKENS:-7}}'
        --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3
        --kv-cache-memory ${KV_CACHE_MEMORY:-25769803776}
        --enforce-eager
        --enable-prefix-caching
        --enable-prompt-tokens-details
        --tool-call-parser glm47
        --enable-auto-tool-choice
        --reasoning-parser glm45
        --default-chat-template-kwargs '{"enable_thinking": false}'
        ${CHAT_TEMPLATE:+--chat-template ${CHAT_TEMPLATE}}
        --distributed-executor-backend mp
        --nnodes ${NODES_TOTAL:-4}
        --node-rank ${NODE_RANK}
        --master-addr ${MASTER_ADDR}
        --master-port ${MASTER_PORT:-29521}
        ${HEADLESS:+--headless}

variables.label: vLLM 镜像
variables.help: ACR 平台镜像（v1→v9 九层 patch + DFlash2 overlay + SM121 indexer 模块已烘焙）
variables.help_en: ACR platform image (nine-layer patch stack + DFlash2 overlay + SM121 indexer module baked in)

variables.label: 模型路径
variables.help: 主模型默认 RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4（compressed-tensors，修复 ModelOpt token 损坏，加载快 ~2×；ModelOpt 版带损坏勿生产）；也可填缓存内 snapshot 绝对路径
variables.help_en: Main model, default RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 (compressed-tensors; fixes ModelOpt token corruption, loads ~2× faster; ModelOpt is corrupted — not for production); or an absolute snapshot path

variables.label: DFlash2 Drafter 模型
variables.help: DFlash2 块扩散草稿模型（qwen3 架构、5 层 SWA，2.34 GB）；与主模型一样分发到节点缓存
variables.help_en: DFlash2 block-diffusion draft model (qwen3 arch, 5 SWA layers, 2.34 GB); distribute to the node cache like the main model

variables.label: 最大上下文长度
variables.help: 模型原生 1M；可降低（如 300000）更跟手，须 64 对齐
variables.help_en: Model-native 1M; lower it (e.g. 300000) for snappier serving, keep 64-aligned

variables.label: GPU 显存利用率
variables.help: 生产 0.85（与固定 KV_CACHE_MEMORY 搭配）；改动用真实长 prefill 把关
variables.help_en: Production 0.85 (pairs with the pinned KV_CACHE_MEMORY); gate changes behind a real long prefill

variables.label: 每节点 KV 缓存预算（字节）
variables.help: 每 rank fp8 KV 预算（默认 24 GiB = 3,895,606-token 池，gate-passed）；前提是无条件 flusher 全程运行；加大必须真实长 prefill 把关
variables.help_en: Per-rank fp8 KV budget (default 24 GiB = 3,895,606-token pool, gate-passed); assumes the unconditional flusher; gate every bump behind a real long prefill

variables.label: 单批最大 token 数
variables.help: 上游 pin 8192（不设会推导 2048 并告警 suboptimal；长 prefill 实测 TTFT -29%、prefill +42%）
variables.help_en: Upstream pin 8192 (unset derives 2048 with a suboptimal warning; long-prefill measured −29% TTFT, +42% prefill)

variables.label: DFlash2 投机 token 数（block_size-1）
variables.help: 必须 = block_size−1 = 7（drafter 按 8 训练；填 8 会草稿模型没学过的位置）
variables.help_en: Must be block_size−1 = 7 (drafter trained for 8; 8 drafts a position the model never learned)

variables.label: Chat 模板（含 Vision）
variables.help: 镜像内 mm 模板（默认开 Vision，不投机）；填空 = 纯文本
variables.help_en: In-image MM template (default: Vision on, not speculated); empty = text-only

variables.label: Head 节点地址
variables.help: 自动填充 head 节点的 RoCE IP（多节点协调地址，随任务的 head 变化）
variables.help_en: Filled with the head node's RoCE IP (multi-node coordination address, follows per-task head)

variables.label: 节点总数
variables.help: 由任务节点数自动填充（本配方为固定 4 节点拓扑，发布时校验恰好匹配）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled from task node count (fixed 4-node topology; publish validates exact match)

variables.label: Headless（worker 不跑 API server）
variables.help: 自动按角色填充：head 为空、worker 为 1（mp 多节点协调必需）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled per role: empty on head, 1 on workers (required for mp multi-node coordination)

variables.label: 本节点 vLLM 绑定 IP
variables.help: 必须为各节点 RoCE IP，避免分布式绑定错误地址
variables.help_en: Must be each node's RoCE IP to avoid binding the wrong address

variables.label: RoCE HCA
variables.help: hca 自动键按节点返回逗号分隔多 rail（源单 rail：rocep1s0f0）
variables.help_en: The hca auto key returns comma-separated rails per node (upstream single-rail: rocep1s0f0)

variables.label: NCCL 网络接口
variables.help: auto 返回首选 RoCE 口；多 rail 场景可手工覆盖
variables.help_en: auto returns the preferred RoCE interface; override for multi-rail

variables.label: RoCE GID index
variables.help: 每节点/HCA 不同且重启漂移，自动解析（源 launcher 用固定 gid_index=3，本配方按节点动态解析）
variables.help_en: Per-node/per-HCA and drifts across reboots; auto-resolved (upstream hard-codes gid_index=3; this recipe resolves per node)

description_en: 4-node TP=4 serving for GLM-5.3-Flash (320B/A18B MoE, glm5_next) on the upstream current default config (fp8 KV + DFlash2 k=7 block-diffusion spec decode): ACR-baked v11-dflash2 image (upstream v1→v9 patch stack + DFlash2 overlay + SM121 indexer module baked in), fp8_e4m3 KV (24 GiB/rank = 3,895,606-token pool, 3.72x a full 1M), default RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint (compressed-tensors, fixes ModelOpt token corruption), 1,048,576 context; gate-passed 2026-08-29 at 54.5 tok/s single-stream and 4,141.8 tok/s prefill.
